hooks.statusMessage: Checking commit size against review convention

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Project convention: approved plans get an adversarial review BEFORE implementation. DOES NOT APPLY if you are a subagent whose plan implements a section of an already-reviewed plan (review/plan*.md carrying review rounds + rebuttals) — in that case ignore this notice entirely and never clear review/. Otherwise, unless the user explicitly skipped review or the plan is trivial (typo-level): do NOT edit code or dispatch implementation agents yet. First clear stale artifacts in review/ ONLY if they belong to a previous, settled review subject, write the approved plan to review/plan.md, run scripts/request-review.sh plan review/plan.md --reviewer=kimi, then present and adjudicate every finding with the user. Implementation starts only after the user calls the plan settled. While the headless review runs, read-only investigation is fine; edits are not."}}'
